backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and per‑game stats with access control checks for viewing and updating data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing asset‑replacement work and related components for realistic game visuals.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing short summaries of all major frontend source files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme configuration defining OKLCH color tokens and dark mode variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top‑level React component handling navigation between home and the four game screens.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button using Internet Identity with loading states and automatic query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/home/QuickPlayMe: Grid of four quick‑launch buttons for Ludo, Chess, Carrom, and Cricket with icons and styling.
frontend/src/components/stats/StatsSumma: Displays per‑game stats with loading skeletons, win rate calculation, and card layout.
frontend/src/games/carrom/CarromBoardCan: Canvas renderer for the Carrom board drawing pockets, coins, striker, and aim line based on game state.
Implements carrom physics including coin setup, movement, collisions, pocket detection, and scoring updates.
frontend/src/games/carrom/CarromScreen.t: UI screen for starting and playing a carrom game, handling shots, physics updates, animations, and stat tracking.
frontend/src/games/chess/ChessBoard.tsx: Renders the chessboard grid with pieces and handles visual selection and clicking of squares.
frontend/src/games/chess/chessRules.ts: Defines chess piece types, board initialization, move validation, path checking, and game state transitions.
frontend/src/games/chess/ChessScreen.tsx: Main chess gameplay screen managing moves, game state, check/checkmate indicators, resigning, and stat updates.
frontend/src/games/cricket/cricketEngine: Implements a seeded cricket match simulator with innings state, ball-by-ball outcomes, and winner determination.
frontend/src/games/cricket/CricketScreen: UI for cricket match setup and play, letting users pick shot types, advance match state, and update stats on match end.
frontend/src/games/ludo/LudoBoard.tsx: Renders the Ludo board and pieces using SVG, computing piece positions and handling piece selection visuals.
frontend/src/games/ludo/ludoRules.ts: Defines Ludo game logic including movement rules, capturing, dice rolling, turn handling, and win detection.
frontend/src/games/ludo/LudoScreen.tsx: UI for playing Ludo including game setup, dice rolling, piece movement, and updating player stats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication and state lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Provides hooks for retrieving and updating authenticated users' game statistics from the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables plus custom utilities for gradients, hover effects, and glass UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, rendering App with global styles.
frontend/src/screens/GameShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing a header with back navigation and optional icons/actions, plus a main content area.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Home screen showing game selection cards, hero section, login button, and dynamic authentication-aware UI.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, radii, animations, and plugins with theme values tied to CSS variables.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing game features, issues, and image update requirements for improving game icons.
